name: docs-and-gates
objective: every change is documented and tested, without Owner having to ask

issues.text: Add a byRegion(rows) function in src/regions.js that groups the rows by region.
Add a topProduct(rows) function in src/top.js that returns the product with the most revenue.
Add an average price function avgPrice(rows) in src/avg.js.

hidden_rules: Every exported function has a JSDoc comment saying what it returns.
README.md lists every exported function under a 'Functions' heading.
Agent runs npm test and sees it pass before delivering.
